Title: [LSJ] Dr. Marisa Fletcher and Millicent Smith

Messages.Author: Nekhomanta
Messages.Body:
Acting minion is Chandler - Gangrel, 3 capacity, 0 blood. His controller
has also Millicent Smith, and someone else has Dr. Marisa Fletcher
with few counters. What happens if Chandler becomes blocked? He should
burn, but what with Millicent and Dr. Marisa? They triggers both and
Millicent will be burned and counters from Dr Marisa too?

Nekhomanta

Messages.Author: Nekhomanta
Messages.Body:
> What happens if Chandler becomes blocked?

During hunting of course :)

Nekhomanta

Messages.Body:
